description: This file contains unit tests for the UserArtifactsManager implementation within the orchestrator package. The tests verify directory creation, listing, error handling for non-existent artifacts, and successful artifact creation with concurrent updates.

methods.name: TestNewDir
methods.description: Tests that creating a new directory via UserArtifactsManager results in the directory actually existing on disk.

methods.name: TestListDirsAndNoDirHasBeenCreated
methods.description: Verifies that listing directories when none have been created returns an empty list.

methods.name: TestListTokens
methods.description: Checks that the list of directories reflects the directories created.

methods.name: TestCreateArtifactDirectoryDoesNotExist
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to update an artifact in a non-existent directory results in an error.

methods.name: TestCreateArtifactsSucceeds
methods.description: Validates successful concurrent creation and writing of artifact chunks, and reading back the accumulated content.
